provenance.unrecovered_source_note: The original Sol 24-finding machine-readable register was not present in surviving branch history and the referenced orphan commit could not be resolved. This file is a reconstruction from surviving audit prose, current source, PR #55 commits, CI evidence, and adversarial reachability checks. It must not be represented as byte-for-byte or item-for-item identical to the lost source.
provenance.reconstruction_rule: A finding appears here only when current repository evidence supports its state. Newly discovered findings are included even when they may not have been in the original 24.

state_vocabulary.CLOSED: Repository implementation and regression evidence exist on the closure branch.
state_vocabulary.OPEN: Repository-side implementation remains incomplete or unsafe.
state_vocabulary.EXTERNAL_GATE: Repository-side implementation is present enough to fail closed, but live/device/provider evidence is still required.
state_vocabulary.SUPERSEDED: Earlier finding was replaced by a more accurate current finding.

findings.title: Canonical Rev 5.1 tree was dropped by later Commander merge
findings.acceptance: Canonical sentinels are present and CI includes the tree-regression guard.

findings.title: Commander authorization trusted caller-provided requested_by identity
findings.acceptance: Gateway/Hermes Commander credentials are distinct and requested_by cannot mint credential-bearing authority.

findings.title: Captured third-party notification/share content had no safe production consumer
findings.acceptance: CONTEXT_INGEST is hardware-proofed, untrusted, authority NONE, and never routed through /v1/commands.

findings.title: Generic Android replay deleted durable SESSION_ENVELOPE before session restoration
findings.acceptance: Generic replayer leaves SESSION_ENVELOPE to VanHermesSessionManager and removes it only through the session consumer.

findings.title: Hermes execution had no deterministic result-to-Mission reconciliation path
findings.acceptance: Hermes reports lifecycle by bound run id; COMPLETED enters gateway verification and Hermes cannot assert VERIFIED_SUCCESS.

findings.title: Full Desktop Commander inherited VM-admin identity
Recovery control was broader than bounded recovery purpose
SPMRF/ChatGPT reviewer inherited VM-admin identity/home permissions
Gateway and Hermes Commander environment/credential binding was ambiguous
Privileged recovery diagnostics could expose sensitive runtime detail
Owner had no deterministic offline reconfirmation surface
Hermes Google capabilities existed but common read-only Workspace functions were not exposed through typed MCP
findings.acceptance: Gmail search, agenda, Drive search, contacts, tasks, status/capabilities and deterministic job planning are exposed; raw mutations are not.

findings.title: Wake-word runtime cannot arm even with an admitted wake asset
findings.detail: pipelineOrNull() returns null after readiness succeeds because no concrete WakeWordEngine/WakePhraseVerifier implementation is shipped. A model file alone cannot close this.

findings.title: Browser Harness private worker service is absent
findings.detail: Bootstrap installs dependencies then records service_state=ENVIRONMENT_PREPARED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; gateway expects a live worker at 127.0.0.1:9141.

findings.title: Stagehand private semantic worker service is absent
findings.detail: Gateway has StagehandAdapter and bounded subagent policy, but no service implements /observe /extract /act /agent at 127.0.0.1:9140.

findings.title: Google mutation routes still accept caller-provided approval booleans outside Action Runtime
findings.detail: These routes are internal-control only and are intentionally not exposed as raw Hermes MCP tools. Closure requires approval to derive from sealed command/action authority, not a boolean parameter.

findings.title: Notification/share ingest producer and gateway schemas drifted
findings.acceptance: Context IDs are stable; notification mapping converts Android fields into gateway intelligence input and share remains untrusted.

findings.title: New context data audit label was outside explicit audit namespace contract
Wake/voice physical-device behavior is not certified on target S24
Google OAuth/provider workflows are not live-certified
n8n automation fabric is not live-certified
VATI live broker path remains outside repository-only certification
Authenticated browser profile persistence/readback not live-certified
Rive embodiment asset/runtime remains externally supplied where native fallback is used
Production Cloudflare authenticated ingress is not certified by quick-tunnel evidence
Hermes live runtime/profile registration must be re-qualified after MCP surface changes

closure_summary.reason: Repository-side OPEN findings remain: local wake engine, Browser Harness worker, Stagehand worker, and Google mutation authority reconciliation.
